notes.title: Lone Apocalypse BETA 0.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]Hello Survivors! Here’s what’s new in BETA 0.0.7:[/h3][olist][*][p]Removed the “X” key switch and the unarmed state to streamline controls and improve gameplay flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated gun models for more detailed and immersive visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt the movement system, making character actions smoother and more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Added drag-and-drop swapping to the quick bar, allowing for easier item and weapon management.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated parts of the map to enhance exploration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several minor bugs for better stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted gameplay values to improve balance.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]⚠️ This is the final update for the old map. In the next version, we will completely remake the map and levels, delivering an entirely new adventure. The update is planned for release in autumn. Thank you for your patience and continued support![/b][/p]

notes.title: “Lone Apocalypse” BETA 0.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3][b][i][u]Warning:[/u][/i][/b][i][u] This update may cause your previous save files to become unusable![/u][/i][/h3][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Level & Experience System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Introduced a brand-new leveling and experience mechanic. Players can now gain XP through combat, gathering, and other activities to unlock more gameplay options and progression rewards.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quick Bar & Item Drag-and-Drop[/b][/p][list][*][p]Items can now be added, replaced, or used directly by dragging them into the quick bar.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Save & Exit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can save their progress and safely exit the game at any time, reducing the risk of losing progress due to unexpected exits.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hotkey UI Toggle[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added hotkey support to quickly open/close certain UI panels for improved efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Russian Localization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added full Russian UI and text support to expand accessibility for more players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Adjustments & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Removal of Power System[/b][/p][list][*][p]The old power system has been removed to create a smoother early-game progression and reduce initial resource pressure.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]The tutorial process, UI hints, and task instructions have been redesigned to improve onboarding for new players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stat Rebalancing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapons, resources, and enemy stats have been rebalanced for a more consistent difficulty curve.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Additional Visual Guidance & Polish[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more UI prompts, interaction markers, and improved certain scene materials for better visual clarity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Monster Pathfinding & AI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed monsters getting stuck or spinning in place in complex terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI combat and chasing behavior for more natural reactions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Depth of Field Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected abnormal depth-of-field effects in certain scenes for a more natural visual presentation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Other Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI misalignment and model clipping issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved responsiveness for certain interactions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Unfinished Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Level Decoration & Content Filling[/b] (postponed to future updates)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keybinding System[/b] (planned for the next update)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]In Russian and English UI, some text may overflow outside the intended frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare AI pathfinding issues may still occur in certain terrains.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Not Supported[/b][/p][list][*][p]Due to unfinished compatibility and performance optimization work, Steam Deck support is currently unavailable. Full Deck support is planned for future updates.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Lone Apocalypse Dev Update | On Recent Media & Early Access Plans
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors![/p][p]Since [i]Lone Apocalypse[/i] launched in Early Access on July 25th, we’ve received an outpouring of interest from players around the world. With only two core developers, we’re working day and night to improve this “scaffolded construction site.” Thank you to everyone who tried the game, left a review, or even requested a refund—every piece of feedback is helping move the project forward.[/p][h3]Why This Announcement[/h3][p]Recently, some media outlets covered our game with humorous headlines like [i]“Experience a AAA Open World Survival Adventure for the Price of a Coffee.”[/i] While we’re grateful for the exposure, such phrasing has unintentionally raised expectations about the game’s scope and level of polish.[/p][p]We want to take this chance to clarify the facts, reaffirm our intended positioning, and share a measurable plan going forward.[/p][h3]Current State of [i]Lone Apocalypse[/i][/h3][p][u][b]Statement: This game is not intended to compete with any major space-themed RPG. Lone Apocalypse is a small-scale survival game set in a post-apocalyptic frozen wasteland. It is not an RPG, and it is currently in an early version where only the foundational framework has been established.[/b][/u][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Available[/p][/th][th][p]Not Available[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Single-player open world survival loop: basic building, extreme weather, Chapter One of the story[/p][/td][td][p]Interstellar travel, space combat, AAA production scale[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Weekly or bi-weekly patches / hotfixes[/p][/td][td][p]Content scope comparable to major space RPGs[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Launch “thank you” price: 49 RUB / 4 CNY[/p][/td][td][p]Final pricing (will gradually increase as features are added)[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]If the current version isn’t your thing, feel free to use Steam’s 14-day / 2-hour refund policy.[/p][h3]Roadmap[/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Timeframe[/p][/th][th][p]Plans[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Near Term (within 1 month)[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Reworked tutorial, balance adjustments, level design updates, partial art asset improvements, more localization languages, UI optimization, etc.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Mid Term (3–6 months)[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Full storyline and gameplay flow, deeper survival and puzzle mechanics, biome and creature variety, improved visuals, sandbox survival mode, etc.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Long Term (6–9 months, tentative)[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Multiplayer features, Steam Workshop support, etc.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Detailed changes will be included with each patch note.[/p][h3]How to Get Involved and Support the Project[/h3][olist][*][p]Steam Community hub to submit bugs or suggestions[/p][/*][*][p]Add to your wishlist, share screenshots, or write a review to help more players discover the game[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks to everyone who has supported, criticized, or simply accompanied us. Let’s keep pushing forward on this frozen island.[/p][p][b]White Leaf Studio[/b]
[b]2025‑07‑29[/b][/p]
